ex.en: He won a scholarship to study in Germany.
ex.zh: 他拿到了去德國留學的獎學金。

ex.en: Tom was able to go to college thanks to a scholarship.
ex.zh: 湯姆靠著獎學金才能上大學。

ex.en: He applied for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 他申請了獎學金。

scholarship.en: money given to a student to help pay for school

ex.en: I prefer a phone with a large screen.
ex.zh: 我更喜歡螢幕大的手機。

ex.en: The screen is giving off green light.
ex.zh: 螢幕閃著綠色的光。

ex.en: Microsoft recently unveiled two new dual screen devices.
ex.zh: 微軟最近推出了兩款雙螢幕裝置。

screen.en: the flat part of a phone, TV or computer where pictures appear

ex.en: "It's so huge!" "Yes, it's an IMAX screen!"
ex.zh: 「好大！」「對，這是 IMAX 銀幕！」

ex.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這部電影從劇本到大銀幕都很成功。

screen.en: the large flat surface where a movie is shown

ex.en: All visitors are screened at the entrance.
ex.zh: 所有訪客在入口都要接受檢查。

ex.en: Women over 40 should be screened for breast cancer.
ex.zh: 四十歲以上的女性應該做乳癌篩檢。

screen.en: to check people or things for problems or danger

ex.en: Follow the schematic to connect the wires.
ex.zh: 照著示意圖接線。

ex.en: The engineer drew a schematic of the circuit.
ex.zh: 工程師畫了一張電路示意圖。

schematic.en: a simple drawing that shows how the parts of something are connected

ex.en: The museum has a famous bronze sculpture.
ex.zh: 這間博物館有一座著名的銅雕。

ex.en: She studied sculpture in Italy.
ex.zh: 她在義大利學雕塑。

sculpture.en: a work of art made by cutting or shaping stone, metal or wood

ex.en: The girl had a long scarf around her neck.
ex.zh: 女孩脖子上圍著一條長圍巾。

ex.en: This scarf feels soft and smooth.
ex.zh: 這條圍巾摸起來又軟又滑。

ex.en: Don't you like my yellow scarf?
ex.zh: 你不喜歡我的黃色圍巾嗎？

scarf.en: a long piece of cloth worn around the neck or head

ex.en: What's the worst-case scenario?
ex.zh: 最壞的情況會是什麼？

ex.en: I'm jumping to the worst-case scenario.
ex.zh: 我老是往最壞的情況想。

ex.en: In the best-case scenario, we'll finish by May.
ex.zh: 最理想的情況下，我們五月就能完成。

scenario.en: a description of how things might happen

ex.en: He admits being involved in the scandal.
ex.zh: 他承認自己涉入這起醜聞。

ex.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.
ex.zh: 那起醜聞讓他聲譽掃地。

ex.en: It was a national scandal.
ex.zh: 這是一起轟動全國的醜聞。

scandal.en: an event that shocks people because someone did something wrong

ex.en: Please get me a scrap of paper.
ex.zh: 請給我一張小紙片。

ex.en: There is not a scrap of truth in his words.
ex.zh: 他說的話沒有半點是真的。

ex.en: The old car was sold for scrap.
ex.zh: 那台舊車被當廢鐵賣掉了。

scrap.en: a small piece of something, or things thrown away

ex.en: The company scrapped the plan due to high costs.
ex.zh: 公司因成本過高而取消了計畫。

ex.en: They decided to scrap the old system.
ex.zh: 他們決定廢掉舊系統。

scrap.en: to decide not to continue with a plan

ex.en: The company's finances are under close scrutiny.
ex.zh: 這家公司的財務正受到嚴格審查。

ex.en: The plan will not stand up to scrutiny.
ex.zh: 這個計畫經不起仔細檢驗。

ex.en: Politicians face constant public scrutiny.
ex.zh: 政治人物時時受到大眾的檢視。

scrutiny.en: a careful and close look at something

ex.en: Rain is scarce in this country.
ex.zh: 這個國家雨量很少。

ex.en: The trees were very scarce.
ex.zh: 樹木非常稀少。

ex.en: Good engineers are scarce these days.
ex.zh: 最近優秀的工程師很難找。

scarce.en: not available in large amounts, so hard to find

ex.en: Overall, the movie was a success from script to screen.
ex.zh: 整體來說，這部電影從劇本到拍攝都很成功。

ex.en: The actors are reading the script together.
ex.zh: 演員們正在一起讀劇本。

ex.en: The call center staff follow a script.
ex.zh: 客服中心的人員照著固定講稿說話。

script.en: the written words of a play, film or speech

ex.en: The syntax of Python scripts is very simple.
ex.zh: Python 腳本的語法很簡單。

ex.en: I wrote a script to back up the files every night.
ex.zh: 我寫了一個腳本，每晚自動備份檔案。

script.en: a short computer program that does a set of tasks

ex.en: The boy scratched his ear.
ex.zh: 那男孩搔了搔耳朵。

ex.en: Your cat scratched me.
ex.zh: 你的貓抓傷我了。

ex.en: Be careful not to scratch the car.
ex.zh: 小心不要刮到車子。

scratch.en: to rub the skin with nails, or to make a thin cut on a surface

ex.en: There's a small scratch on my phone screen.
ex.zh: 我的手機螢幕上有一道小刮痕。

ex.en: The table has a few scratches.
ex.zh: 這張桌子有幾道刮痕。

scratch.en: a thin mark or small cut made by something sharp

scratch.zh: from scratch：從頭開始、從零開始

ex.en: Have I got to do it from scratch?
ex.zh: 我得從頭開始做嗎？

ex.en: We built the app from scratch.
ex.zh: 我們從零開始打造這個 App。

scratch.en: from the very beginning, with nothing prepared before

ex.en: There are beautiful flowers scattered throughout the garden.
ex.zh: 花園裡到處開著美麗的花。

ex.en: Books are scattered around the room.
ex.zh: 書散落在房間各處。

ex.en: Don't scatter your things about.
ex.zh: 不要把你的東西到處亂放。

scatter.en: to throw or drop things so that they spread over a wide area

ex.en: The crowd scattered when it started to rain.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時人群四散。

ex.en: My family is scattered across three countries.
ex.zh: 我的家人分散在三個國家。

scatter.en: to leave quickly in different directions

ex.en: Please write your score on the scorecard.
ex.zh: 請把你的分數寫在記分卡上。

ex.en: The company uses a scorecard to measure performance.
ex.zh: 公司用評分表來衡量績效。

scorecard.en: a card or sheet used to write down points or results

ex.en: How many schools are there in your city?
ex.zh: 你們城市有幾所學校？

ex.en: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.
ex.zh: 今天許多學校因暴風雨停課。

school.en: a place where children go to learn

ex.en: You don't have to go to school on Sunday.
ex.zh: 你星期天不用上學。

ex.en: Instead of going to school, he stayed at home.
ex.zh: 他沒去上學，待在家裡。

school.en: the time spent learning at a place of education

ex.en: She studied at a business school.
ex.zh: 她讀的是商學院。

ex.en: He's applying to law school.
ex.zh: 他正在申請法學院。

school.en: a part of a university that teaches one subject

ex.en: Science has brought about many changes to our lives.
ex.zh: 科學為我們的生活帶來了許多的改變。

ex.en: In recent years, science has made remarkable progress.
ex.zh: 這幾年科學有了顯著的進步。

ex.en: Mathematics are the foundation of all sciences.
ex.zh: 數學是所有科學的基礎。

science.en: the study of the natural world through tests and careful watching

ex.en: The natural sciences are harder than the social sciences.
ex.zh: 自然科學比社會科學難。

ex.en: Computer science is a popular major.
ex.zh: 資訊科學是熱門的主修科系。

science.en: a particular area of study, such as biology or physics

ex.en: The police got to the scene of the accident.
ex.zh: 警察到了事故現場。

ex.en: The police will soon arrive on the scene.
ex.zh: 警方很快就會趕到現場。

ex.en: It's like a scene from a movie, isn't it?
ex.zh: 簡直就像電影裡的一幕，對吧？

ex.en: This is my favorite scene in the movie.
ex.zh: 這是電影裡我最喜歡的一幕。

scene.en: a short part of a film or play in one place

ex.en: The beauty of the scene was beyond description.
ex.zh: 那裡的景色美得難以形容。

ex.en: The night scene from the mountain is amazing.
ex.zh: 從山上看的夜景非常美。

scene.en: something you see, especially a view of a place

ex.en: It seems the rural area will be developed on a large scale.
ex.zh: 鄉村地區似乎要大規模開發了。

ex.en: The project is on a much larger scale than last year.
ex.zh: 這個專案規模比去年大很多。

scale.en: the size or amount of something

ex.en: On a scale from 1 to 10, how have you been feeling?
ex.zh: 從一到十分，你最近感覺怎麼樣？

ex.en: The map is drawn to scale.
ex.zh: 這張地圖是按比例繪製的。

scale.en: a set of numbered marks or levels used to measure something

ex.en: Please put your baggage on this scale.
ex.zh: 請把您的行李放在這個秤上。

ex.en: I weighed myself on the bathroom scales.
ex.zh: 我用浴室的體重計量體重。

scale.en: a machine used to find out how heavy something is

scale.zh: scale up / down：擴大／縮減規模

ex.en: We plan to scale up production next year.
ex.zh: 我們計畫明年擴大生產規模。

ex.en: The company had to scale down its plans.
ex.zh: 公司不得不縮減計畫。

scale.en: to make something bigger or smaller in size or amount

ex.en: Your help is indispensable for the success of the scheme.
ex.zh: 沒有你的幫忙，這個計畫就無法成功。

ex.en: He carried out the scheme faithfully.
ex.zh: 他忠實地執行了這項計畫。

ex.en: The government launched a new pension scheme.
ex.zh: 政府推出了新的退休金方案。

scheme.en: an organized plan for doing something

ex.en: He was involved in a scheme to cheat investors.
ex.zh: 他涉入一場詐騙投資人的陰謀。

ex.en: It was all part of a clever scheme.
ex.zh: 這一切都是一個巧妙詭計的一部分。

scheme.en: a secret plan to do something dishonest

ex.en: He wants to be a scientist in the future.
ex.zh: 他將來想當科學家。

ex.en: Scientists can easily compute the distance between planets.
ex.zh: 科學家能輕易算出行星之間的距離。

ex.en: Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.
ex.zh: 科學家正努力終結愛滋病。

scientist.en: a person who studies the natural world and does tests

ex.en: There is no scientific basis for these claims.
ex.zh: 這些說法沒有科學根據。

ex.en: The scientific name of dog is "Canis familiaris".
ex.zh: 狗的學名是「Canis familiaris」。

ex.en: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
ex.zh: 大多數科學突破只不過是發現了顯而易見的事。

scientific.en: related to science, or done in a careful and exact way

ex.en: I didn't mean to scare you.
ex.zh: 我不是故意要嚇你的。

ex.en: He was scared when the monkey jumped at him.
ex.zh: 猴子撲向他時，他嚇了一跳。

ex.en: You gave me a scare!
ex.zh: 你嚇了我一跳！

ex.en: The food safety scare hurt the restaurant's business.
ex.zh: 食安風波重創了這家餐廳的生意。

scare.en: a sudden feeling of fear, or worry shared by many people

ex.en: I heard someone scream.
ex.zh: 我聽到有人尖叫。

ex.en: There was a minute of silence and then everybody started screaming.
ex.zh: 沉默了一分鐘之後，大家開始尖叫。

scream.en: to cry out loudly in a high voice

ex.en: We heard a loud scream from upstairs.
ex.zh: 我們聽到樓上傳來一聲尖叫。

ex.en: She let out a scream when she saw the spider.
ex.zh: 她看到蜘蛛時尖叫了一聲。

scream.en: a loud, high cry of fear, pain or excitement

ex.en: People thought him to be a great scholar.
ex.zh: 人們認為他是一位偉大的學者。

ex.en: Mr Tani is not so much a scholar as a journalist.
ex.zh: 谷先生與其說是學者，不如說是記者。

ex.en: According to some scholars, a major earthquake could occur at any moment now.
ex.zh: 根據一些學者的說法，現在隨時可能發生大地震。

scholar.en: a person who has studied a subject deeply

ex.en: Please scan the document and email it to me.
ex.zh: 請把文件掃描後寄給我。

ex.en: The cashier scanned the items quickly.
ex.zh: 收銀員很快地掃描了商品。

scan.en: to use a machine to read a page or code and copy it into a computer

ex.en: I scanned the report for key figures.
ex.zh: 我快速瀏覽報告找關鍵數字。

ex.en: She scanned the crowd for her friend.
ex.zh: 她在人群中搜尋朋友的身影。

scan.en: to look at something quickly to find the main points

ex.en: The doctor ordered a brain scan.
ex.zh: 醫生安排了腦部掃描。

ex.en: The scan showed nothing unusual.
ex.zh: 掃描結果沒有發現異常。

scan.en: a medical test that makes a picture of the inside of the body

ex.en: She reads scripture every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上讀經。

ex.en: The monks study ancient Buddhist scriptures.
ex.zh: 僧侶們研讀古老的佛經。

ex.en: Scroll down to see more photos.
ex.zh: 往下滑可以看到更多照片。

ex.en: I spent an hour scrolling through social media.
ex.zh: 我花了一個小時滑社群媒體。

scroll.en: to move text or pictures up or down on a screen

ex.en: The museum displays ancient Chinese scrolls.
ex.zh: 博物館展示古代中國的卷軸。

ex.en: He unrolled the scroll carefully.
ex.zh: 他小心翼翼地展開卷軸。

scroll.en: a long piece of paper rolled up, with writing or a picture on it

ex.en: This place is famous for its scenic beauty.
ex.zh: 這個地方以風景優美聞名。

ex.en: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
ex.zh: 瑞士以風景優美聞名。

ex.en: Let's take the scenic route along the coast.
ex.zh: 我們走沿海那條風景優美的路線吧。

ex.en: In the last minute, Marcello scored an equalizing goal.
ex.zh: 最後一分鐘，馬塞洛踢進一球，把比分扳平。

ex.en: The opposition formed a line in the box to try and block Messi from scoring.
ex.zh: 對手在禁區內排成一道人牆，想阻止梅西射門得分。

score.en: to get a point or goal in a game

ex.en: She is not in the least worried about her test scores.
ex.zh: 她一點也不擔心考試成績。

ex.en: What's the score now?
ex.zh: 現在比數多少？

score.en: the number of points a person or team has in a game or test

ex.en: In the scorching heat, the cat is spread out lethargically on the ground.
ex.zh: 在酷熱的天氣裡，貓咪懶洋洋地攤在地上。

ex.en: It was a scorching day, over 38 degrees.
ex.zh: 那天熱得要命，超過 38 度。

ex.en: With Renaissance, scholastic ideas gave place to positive ideas.
ex.zh: 隨著文藝復興，學院派的想法被積極的想法取而代之了。

ex.en: She won an award for her scholastic achievement.
ex.zh: 她因學業成就而獲獎。

ex.en: The scholastic year begins in September.
ex.zh: 學年從九月開始。

ex.en: I was scared to be alone in the dark.
ex.zh: 我害怕一個人處在黑暗之中。

ex.en: She was so scared that she couldn't speak.
ex.zh: 她害怕得連話也說不出來。

ex.en: He told me that he wasn't scared of snakes.
ex.zh: 他告訴我他不怕蛇。

ex.en: I have never read such a scary novel.
ex.zh: 我從沒讀過那麼恐怖的小說。

ex.en: This horror movie is really scary. I couldn't sleep after I watched it.
ex.zh: 這部恐怖片很嚇人，我一看就睡不著覺了。

ex.en: The wind sounds scary, like screaming ghosts.
ex.zh: 風聲有點恐怖，聽起來好像鬼叫一般。

ex.en: I'll still have a scar from that accident.
ex.zh: 我還留著那起事故的傷疤。

ex.en: The scar on his forehead really stands out.
ex.zh: 他額頭上的疤痕很醒目。

ex.en: The surgery left a small scar on her stomach.
ex.zh: 手術在她肚子上留下了一道小疤痕。

scar.en: a mark left on the skin after a wound has healed

ex.en: The burn scarred his arm for life.
ex.zh: 那次燙傷在他手臂上留下了一輩子的疤。

ex.en: If you keep picking at the wound, it will scar.
ex.zh: 如果你一直摳傷口，就會留疤。

scar.en: to leave a mark on the skin after a wound heals

ex.en: You mustn't answer your mother back when she scolds you.
ex.zh: 媽媽罵你的時候，你不可以回嘴。

ex.en: The professor scolded John for skipping class.
ex.zh: 約翰翹課，被教授罵了一頓。

ex.en: I got scolded severely by that teacher.
ex.zh: 我被那位老師嚴厲斥責了。

scold.en: to tell someone angrily that they have done something wrong

ex.en: She looked at his cheap gift with scorn.
ex.zh: 她用輕蔑的眼神看著他送的廉價禮物。

ex.en: His idea was met with scorn by the other members.
ex.zh: 他的想法遭到其他成員的嘲笑。

scorn.en: a strong feeling that someone or something is not good enough to respect

ex.en: She scorned the boy.
ex.zh: 她瞧不起那個男孩。

ex.en: Don't scorn people just because they are poor.
ex.zh: 不要只因為別人窮就瞧不起他們。

scorn.en: to feel or show that someone is not good enough to respect

ex.en: All applicants go through a phone screening first.
ex.zh: 所有應徵者都要先經過電話篩選。

ex.en: Regular cancer screening can save lives.
ex.zh: 定期做癌症篩檢可以救命。

screening.en: the checking of people or things to find problems or choose the right ones

ex.en: There's a free screening of the film tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚有這部電影的免費放映。

ex.en: The director attended the first screening.
ex.zh: 導演出席了首映。

screening.en: a showing of a film to an audience

ex.en: Tom, can you show Mary how to use the scanner?
ex.zh: 湯姆，你能教瑪麗用掃描器嗎？

ex.en: The scanner saved each signed form as a searchable PDF.
ex.zh: 掃描器將每份已簽署的表格存成可搜尋的 PDF。

scanner.en: a machine that reads pages or codes and copies them into a computer

ex.en: They designed a scalable system for future growth.
ex.zh: 他們設計了一套可配合未來成長擴充的系統。

ex.en: The solution is scalable across multiple branches.
ex.zh: 這套解決方案可擴展至多個分部。

scalable.en: able to grow bigger or handle more work easily

ex.en: Scalability matters as the customer base grows.
ex.zh: 客戶群擴大時，系統的擴充性就很重要。

ex.en: The team tested the platform's scalability.
ex.zh: 團隊測試了這個平台的擴展能力。

scalability.en: the ability of a system to grow and handle more work

ex.en: Workers inspected the scaffolding before climbing it.
ex.zh: 工人爬上鷹架前先做了檢查。

ex.en: The crew removed the scaffolding after the repairs.
ex.zh: 修繕完成後，施工團隊拆除了鷹架。

scaffolding.en: a temporary frame of poles and boards that workers stand on beside a building

ex.en: The scenery at this mountain is very beautiful.
ex.zh: 這座山的景色非常美。

ex.en: It's the most beautiful scenery I've ever seen.
ex.zh: 這是我見過最美的景色。

ex.en: Tom and Mary admired the scenery as they held hands.
ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗手牽著手，一起欣賞風景。

scenery.en: the natural views of a place, such as hills and trees

ex.en: This is beyond the scope of my imagination.
ex.zh: 這超出了我的想像範圍。

ex.en: That question is beyond the scope of this meeting.
ex.zh: 那個問題不在這次會議的討論範圍內。

scope.en: the range of things that something covers or deals with

ex.en: The schedule is only slightly affected by this delay.
ex.zh: 這次延誤對時程的影響很小。

ex.en: I do not know the train schedules, could you find out for me?
ex.zh: 我不知道火車時刻表，你能幫我查一下嗎？

ex.en: We should have taken the schedule into consideration.
ex.zh: 我們應該把時程考慮進去的。

schedule.en: a list of planned events with their times

ex.en: The server reboot is scheduled at 9 o'clock this evening.
ex.zh: 伺服器預定在今晚 9 點重新開機。

ex.en: Secondly, is there any project scheduled to be released today?
ex.zh: 第二，今天有預定要發布的專案嗎？

schedule.en: to plan something to happen at a certain time

ex.en: I could scarcely believe the good news.
ex.zh: 我簡直不敢相信這個好消息。

ex.en: There was scarcely any food left in the fridge.
ex.zh: 冰箱裡幾乎沒剩什麼食物。

ex.en: She had scarcely arrived when the phone rang.
ex.zh: 她才剛到，電話就響了。

ex.en: We scrambled up the rocky hill to reach the top.
ex.zh: 我們手腳並用爬上多石的山丘登頂。

ex.en: The children scrambled over the fence to get their ball.
ex.zh: 孩子們爬過籬笆去拿他們的球。

ex.en: Fans scrambled for the best seats in the stadium.
ex.zh: 球迷們爭先恐後地搶體育場裡最好的位子。

ex.en: I had to scramble to finish the report before noon.
ex.zh: 我得手忙腳亂地趕在中午前完成報告。

ex.en: I usually scramble two eggs for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐通常會炒兩顆蛋。

ex.en: He scrambled some eggs with tomatoes and onions.
ex.zh: 他用番茄和洋蔥炒了一些蛋。

ex.en: The scent of fresh bread filled the kitchen.
ex.zh: 新鮮麵包的香味充滿了廚房。

ex.en: I love the scent of roses in the garden.
ex.zh: 我喜歡花園裡玫瑰的香氣。

ex.en: She wears a light scent every day.
ex.zh: 她每天都擦淡淡的香水。

ex.en: He gave her a bottle of scent for her birthday.
ex.zh: 他送她一瓶香水當生日禮物。

ex.en: The dog scented a rabbit in the grass.
ex.zh: 狗聞到草叢裡有隻兔子。

ex.en: Flowers scented the whole room.
ex.zh: 花香瀰漫了整個房間。

ex.en: I need a screw to fix the table leg.
ex.zh: 我需要一根螺絲來修理桌腳。

ex.en: One screw fell out and rolled under the sofa.
ex.zh: 有一根螺絲掉了出來，滾到沙發底下。

ex.en: Please screw the lid on tightly after use.
ex.zh: 使用完請把蓋子旋緊。

ex.en: He screwed the shelf to the wall himself.
ex.zh: 他自己把層架用螺絲鎖在牆上。

ex.en: Scotland is the northern part of the United Kingdom.
ex.zh: 蘇格蘭位於英國北部。

ex.en: Edinburgh is the capital of Scotland.
ex.zh: 愛丁堡是蘇格蘭的首府。

ex.en: They went hiking in the mountains of Scotland last summer.
ex.zh: 他們去年夏天到蘇格蘭的山區健行。

ex.en: The Scottish countryside is famous for its green hills.
ex.zh: 蘇格蘭的鄉間以綠色丘陵聞名。

ex.en: We listened to some traditional Scottish music.
ex.zh: 我們聽了一些傳統的蘇格蘭音樂。

ex.en: She has a Scottish friend who lives in Edinburgh.
ex.zh: 她有一位住在愛丁堡的蘇格蘭朋友。

ex.en: Scott is a name that is often used for boys.
ex.zh: 斯科特是常被用來替男孩取的名字。

ex.en: Scott invited us over for dinner on Saturday.
ex.zh: 斯科特邀請我們星期六去他家吃晚飯。

ex.en: He scraped the ice off the car window.
ex.zh: 他把車窗上的冰刮掉。

ex.en: Scrape the burnt part off the toast before eating.
ex.zh: 吃之前先把吐司燒焦的部分刮掉。

ex.en: She fell and scraped her knee on the road.
ex.zh: 她跌倒了，膝蓋在路上擦傷。

ex.en: The car scraped against the wall while parking.
ex.zh: 車子停車時擦到了牆。

ex.en: He got a small scrape on his arm.
ex.zh: 他的手臂上有一小塊擦傷。

ex.en: The door had a long scrape across it.
ex.zh: 那扇門上有一道長長的刮痕。

ex.en: She published a scholarly article on ancient poetry.
ex.zh: 她發表了一篇關於古代詩歌的學術文章。

ex.en: The library has a large collection of scholarly books.
ex.zh: 圖書館有大量學術書籍的館藏。

ex.en: I'm sceptical about claims that sound too good to be true.
ex.zh: 對聽起來好得不像真的說法，我抱持懷疑。

ex.en: The scientists were sceptical of the results.
ex.zh: 科學家對這些結果存疑。

ex.en: I'd like two scoops of chocolate ice cream, please.
ex.zh: 我想要兩球巧克力冰淇淋，謝謝。

ex.en: Add one scoop of coffee powder to the cup.
ex.zh: 在杯子裡加一勺咖啡粉。

ex.en: He scooped some rice into the bowl.
ex.zh: 他舀了一些米飯到碗裡。

ex.en: She scooped the sand out of the bucket.
ex.zh: 她把沙子從桶子裡舀出來。

ex.en: The reporter got a scoop about the new mayor.
ex.zh: 那位記者搶到一則關於新市長的獨家新聞。

ex.en: Every newspaper wanted the scoop on the story.
ex.zh: 每家報紙都想搶到這則故事的獨家報導。

ex.en: He kept scoring goals in every match this season.
ex.zh: 他這季每場比賽都持續進球。

ex.en: She is scoring high on all her math tests.
ex.zh: 她每次數學考試都拿高分。

ex.en: The scoring system in this game is easy to learn.
ex.zh: 這個遊戲的計分方式很容易學會。

ex.en: Scoring in basketball depends on speed and teamwork.
ex.zh: 籃球的得分要靠速度與團隊合作。

ex.en: My cousin is a scout who goes camping every summer.
ex.zh: 我表弟是童子軍，每年夏天都去露營。

ex.en: The scouts learned how to build a fire safely.
ex.zh: 童子軍們學會了如何安全地生火。

ex.en: A talent scout noticed the young singer at the school concert.
ex.zh: 一位星探在學校音樂會上注意到這位年輕歌手。

ex.en: Baseball scouts came to watch the high school pitcher.
ex.zh: 棒球球探前來觀看這位高中投手。

ex.en: We sent two people ahead to scout the road.
ex.zh: 我們派了兩個人先去探路。

ex.en: The company is scouting for a new location for its store.
ex.zh: 公司正在物色店面的新地點。

ex.en: Many people greeted the new plan with scepticism.
ex.zh: 許多人對這個新計畫抱持懷疑。

ex.en: A healthy dose of scepticism will protect you from false claims.
ex.zh: 適度的懷疑可以避免你被假消息騙倒。

ex.en: The schoolboy ran to catch the morning bus.
ex.zh: 那個男學生跑著去趕早上的公車。

ex.en: Every schoolboy in the village knew the old story.
ex.zh: 村裡每個男孩都知道這個老故事。

ex.en: She wore a scarlet scarf on the cold morning.
ex.zh: 寒冷的早晨，她圍了一條緋紅色的圍巾。

ex.en: The scarlet leaves looked bright against the grey sky.
ex.zh: 緋紅色的葉子在灰色的天空下顯得鮮亮。

ex.en: The sunset turned the sky a deep scarlet.
ex.zh: 夕陽把天空染成深緋紅色。

ex.en: Her favorite color is scarlet.
ex.zh: 她最喜歡的顏色是緋紅色。

ex.en: Her schooling was interrupted when the family moved abroad.
ex.zh: 她的學業因為舉家搬到國外而中斷。

ex.en: Many children in the region receive little formal schooling.
ex.zh: 該地區許多孩子只受過很少的正規學校教育。

ex.en: The scheduled meeting begins at nine o'clock.
ex.zh: 預定的會議九點開始。

ex.en: Our scheduled flight was delayed by an hour.
ex.zh: 我們預定的航班延誤了一小時。

ex.en: She scrubbed the pan until it was clean.
ex.zh: 她把平底鍋刷到乾乾淨淨。

ex.en: I need to scrub the bathroom floor today.
ex.zh: 我今天得刷洗浴室地板。

ex.en: Wild goats walked through the dry scrub.
ex.zh: 野山羊走過乾燥的灌木叢。

ex.en: The hill was covered with thick scrub.
ex.zh: 山丘上長滿了濃密的矮樹叢。

ex.en: Scattered showers are expected this afternoon.
ex.zh: 預計今天下午會有零星陣雨。

ex.en: Small villages are scattered across the hills.
ex.zh: 小村莊零散分布在山丘之間。

ex.en: Toys lay scattered all over the floor.
ex.zh: 玩具散落在整個地板上。

ex.en: His scattered notes were hard to read.
ex.zh: 他散亂的筆記很難讀。

ex.en: The inspector scrutinized every page of the contract.
ex.zh: 檢查員仔細審查了合約的每一頁。

ex.en: Voters will scrutinize the plan before the election.
ex.zh: 選民在選舉前會仔細檢視這項計畫。

ex.en: She speaks with a soft Scots accent.
ex.zh: 她說話帶著輕柔的蘇格蘭口音。

ex.en: Scots law is different from English law.
ex.zh: 蘇格蘭法律與英格蘭法律不同。

ex.en: The sculptor spent six months carving a lion out of a single block of stone.
ex.zh: 那位雕刻家花了六個月，用一整塊石頭雕出一隻獅子。

ex.en: My aunt is a sculptor, and her studio is full of clay figures.
ex.zh: 我阿姨是雕刻家，她的工作室裡擺滿了黏土人像。

ex.en: A layer of green scum floated on top of the pond.
ex.zh: 池塘表面浮著一層綠色的浮渣。

ex.en: Wash the scum off the sink with a stiff brush.
ex.zh: 用硬毛刷把水槽上的污垢刷掉。

ex.en: The shampoo is made for a dry, itchy scalp.
ex.zh: 這款洗髮精是為乾燥發癢的頭皮設計的。

ex.en: She gently massaged her scalp in the shower.
ex.zh: 她在淋浴時輕輕按摩頭皮。

ex.en: He was caught scalping concert tickets outside the stadium.
ex.zh: 他在體育場外倒賣演唱會門票被抓。

ex.en: Some people scalp tickets for double the price.
ex.zh: 有些人以兩倍價格倒賣門票。

ex.en: Could you pass me the scissors, please?
ex.zh: 可以請你把剪刀遞給我嗎？

ex.en: These scissors are too dull to cut the paper.
ex.zh: 這把剪刀太鈍了，剪不斷紙。

ex.en: She cut the ribbon with a pair of scissors.
ex.zh: 她用一把剪刀剪斷了緞帶。

ex.en: A Scotsman played the bagpipes outside the castle.
ex.zh: 一位蘇格蘭人在城堡外吹奏風笛。

ex.en: My neighbour is a Scotsman who moved here ten years ago.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是十年前搬來的蘇格蘭人。

ex.en: The email about winning a free phone was a scam.
ex.zh: 那封說你中了免費手機的電子郵件是個騙局。

ex.en: Elderly people are often the targets of phone scams.
ex.zh: 年長者常常是電話詐騙的目標。

ex.en: Criminals scammed hundreds of people out of their savings.
ex.zh: 罪犯騙走了數百人的積蓄。

ex.en: I almost got scammed when I bought tickets online.
ex.zh: 我在網路上買票時差點被騙。

ex.en: There is scant evidence to support his story.
ex.zh: 幾乎沒有證據能支持他的說法。

ex.en: The room received scant light through the tiny window.
ex.zh: 那間房間只從小窗透進一點點光。

ex.en: He was the top scorer in the league this season.
ex.zh: 他是本季聯賽的得分王。

ex.en: The scorer wrote down every point during the game.
ex.zh: 記分員在比賽中記下每一分。

ex.en: The mice scurried across the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 老鼠急匆匆地跑過廚房地板。

ex.en: Shoppers scurried for shelter when it began to rain.
ex.zh: 開始下雨時，購物的人們急忙跑去躲雨。

ex.en: We heard the scurry of little feet in the attic.
ex.zh: 我們聽到閣樓裡傳來小腳急跑的聲音。

ex.en: There was a scurry to find seats before the show.
ex.zh: 演出前大家匆忙地去找座位。

ex.en: The teacher drew a schema to show how the system works.
ex.zh: 老師畫了一張架構圖來說明系統如何運作。

ex.en: We must agree on the database schema before we start coding.
ex.zh: 開始寫程式前，我們必須先確定資料庫的結構。

ex.en: He spent two years writing the screenplay for his first film.
ex.zh: 他花了兩年寫他第一部電影的劇本。

ex.en: The screenplay won an award for its clever dialogue.
ex.zh: 這份劇本因機智的對白而獲獎。

ex.en: Police scoured the forest for the missing hiker.
ex.zh: 警方搜遍森林尋找失蹤的登山客。

ex.en: I scoured the shops for a birthday gift.
ex.zh: 我逛遍各家店找生日禮物。

ex.en: She scoured the burnt pan with a steel brush.
ex.zh: 她用鋼刷刷洗燒焦的鍋子。

ex.en: You need to scour the bathtub to remove the stains.
ex.zh: 你得用力刷洗浴缸才能去掉污漬。

ex.en: A scarcity of water forced the village to move.
ex.zh: 缺水迫使這個村莊搬遷。

ex.en: The scarcity of jobs made many young people leave.
ex.zh: 工作機會稀少使許多年輕人離開。

ex.en: Scarcity can make a simple item more valuable.
ex.zh: 稀少會讓一件普通物品變得更有價值。

ex.en: The Scandinavian next to me spoke very good English.
ex.zh: 坐在我旁邊的那位斯堪地那維亞人英文說得很好。

ex.en: Many Scandinavians enjoy spending time outdoors in winter.
ex.zh: 許多斯堪地那維亞人喜歡在冬天到戶外活動。

ex.zh: 她喜歡北歐風家具，因為簡約。

ex.en: We took a trip to several Scandinavian countries.
ex.zh: 我們去了幾個北歐國家旅行。

ex.en: I can't read your scribble; please write more clearly.
ex.zh: 我看不懂你潦草的字跡，請寫清楚一點。

ex.zh: 牆上塗滿了小孩的塗鴉。

ex.en: She scribbled her phone number on a napkin.
ex.zh: 她把電話號碼潦草地寫在餐巾紙上。

ex.zh: 他在上課時草草地記筆記。

ex.zh: 這個說法尚未獲得科學證實。

ex.zh: 我們用縝密的實驗以科學方法測試這個想法。
